summary: Tested the 3 new features (admin impersonation, chat username label, Sertex removal). Backend 100% pass (7/7). Frontend impersonation flow works end-to-end (banner + YÖNETİCİYE DÖN + localStorage swap all correct). Chat user label correctly shows uppercase username (SERKAN / AHMET) instead of USER. Assistant identifies as Sertex in real GPT-5.2 reply (no Sertex). TWO bugs found: (1) thinking indicator still shows 'Sertex' text — should be 'SERTEX'. (2) On impersonation, sidebar conversation list is NOT refetched, so admin still sees their own conversations in the sidebar even though /api/conversations correctly returns the target user's data. Also causes 404 errors when the impersonated user tries to send to a stale conversation_id.

ui_bugs.issue: Thinking indicator (data-testid='thinking-indicator') hard-codes the text 'Sertex' instead of 'SERTEX'. Review request explicitly requires: 'Thinking indicator says SERTEX not Sertex'. Confirmed by e2e Playwright test — text content of the thinking indicator was 'Sertex' while awaiting a chat reply.

integration_issues.flow: Admin impersonation → user data isolation in Sidebar
integration_issues.issue: When admin clicks admin-view-{user} Eye button, the SertexMain state (conversationId + messages) and Sidebar conversation list are NOT reset/refetched. Backend /api/conversations correctly returns 0 items for ahmet (verified via API call inside test), but the sidebar still displays serkan's 7-8 conversations. Also causes a 404 (`Failed to load resource: 404`) when the impersonated user's first chat attempts to POST /chat with the stale `conversation_id` (which belongs to serkan). Review request explicitly says 'Sidebar now shows ahmet's tasks/notes/history (not serkan's)' — this is broken. Suggested fix: in auth.js `impersonate()` after setToken/setUser, dispatch a state reset (or use `user.id` as a key on Sidebar / SertexMain), or force `window.location.reload()` on start of impersonation (mirroring the reload done on stopImpersonating).

action_items: Fix ChatMessages.jsx line 81 — replace 'Sertex' text in thinking indicator with 'SERTEX'.

Fix Sidebar / SertexMain to refetch conversations + notes + tasks and reset conversationId/messages state when impersonation starts (mirror the reload done on stop-impersonation). Simplest fix: `window.location.reload()` inside auth.js `impersonate()` after saving the backup and setting the new token. Alternative: use `user?.id` as React key on the root layout so all children remount on user swap.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.js `impersonate()` swaps the token+user in-place but does not invalidate the app's cached UI state (Sidebar conversations, SertexMain conversationId+messages). This is why stop-impersonation uses window.location.reload() to be safe — the same treatment (or equivalent) is needed on start of impersonation.
server.py::admin_impersonate returns a role=user token even for admin→admin impersonation. Not tested here explicitly, but this is intentional per the model of impersonation; noting for awareness.

SYSTEM_PROMPT_TR is correct (server.py L312-320) — it explicitly instructs 'başka isim (Sertex gibi) kullanma'. Real GPT-5.2 reply verified — assistant identified as Sertex ('Selam efendim') without mentioning Sertex.
ChatMessages.jsx line 81 is the ONLY user-visible 'Sertex' string left in the app. All others are internal component/file names (SertexMain.jsx export) which are fine to keep.

success_rate.frontend: 80% — impersonation banner, YÖNETİCİYE DÖN, localStorage swap, admin-view-{username} testids, own-user disabled Eye, uppercase username label, assistant identifies as Sertex all PASS. 2 bugs: thinking indicator says Sertex + sidebar not refreshed on impersonation start.

Chat identity test uses real GPT-5.2 and asserts no 'sertex' in reply. On retest after fix: (1) re-verify thinking indicator text now says 'SERTEX', (2) re-verify sidebar conversation list refreshes when impersonation begins (should show 0 items for ahmet, then re-populate on the admin side after stop-impersonation reload). rca of the issue: Bug 1 (Sertex in thinking indicator): src/components/ChatMessages.jsx line 81 hard-codes the string 'Sertex' inside the thinking indicator block. When the chat is awaiting an assistant reply this string appears in the UI. Fix: change 'Sertex' → 'SERTEX' on that line. Bug 2 (sidebar stale on impersonation): src/lib/auth.js `impersonate()` (lines 64-78) sets token+user but does not clear/refetch app state (Sidebar internally fetches /api/conversations on mount and on refreshKey change; the Sidebar is not remounted on user change; refreshKey is only bumped after a successful chat). Meanwhile stopImpersonating always calls window.location.reload() (SertexMain.jsx line 149) which side-steps this. Simplest symmetric fix: window.location.reload() in impersonate() after setToken+localStorage backup. This also resets SertexMain's conversationId/messages state, avoiding the stale-conversation 404.
